description: Find faces, edges, vertices, or solid bodies in the revision-bound artifact returned by inspect, optionally scoped to an assembly component_name. Use this before measure, because every measurement names entity IDs rather than coordinates, and follow pagination until has_more is false whenever a count or a minimum matters. Faces support surface_type, area, and radius filters (e.g. { surface_type: "cylinder", min_radius: 2 }); edges support curve_type, length, and radius; vertices return coordinates and bodies return volume. IDs are producer- and revision-scoped: they are valid only for this server and only for the artifact revision that returned them, so never reuse them after the file changes or in another tool. Occurrence IDs distinguish repeated component instances. distance takes sources/targets; every other measure kind takes entity_ids, and cad://help lists the required fields for each kind.

artifact.description: Revision-bound STEP reference from inspect (uri + sha256 revision). The revision must still match the file on disk.

revision.description: sha256 revision returned by inspect. Rejected if the file changed since then, which is what keeps IDs and measurements bound to one revision.

units.description: Spatial unit of the source file; echoed from inspect.

uri.description: Same STEP file the revision came from, as a file: URI or absolute path.

component_name.description: Optional component scope from inspect.structure.component_occurrences; use the base name for all repeated instances or the full name#instance ID for one occurrence.

curve_type.description: Edges only: keep edges of this curve type.

entity_ids.description: Optional explicit ids to return; each must match entity_type (e.g. ["face:3"]).

limit.description: Maximum entities to return in this page (default 50).

max_area.description: Faces only: maximum face area in mm².

max_length.description: Edges only: maximum edge length in mm.

max_radius.description: Faces/edges only: maximum radius in mm.

min_area.description: Faces only: minimum face area in mm².

min_length.description: Edges only: minimum edge length in mm.

min_radius.description: Faces/edges only: minimum radius in mm.

offset.description: Entities to skip; follow pagination.has_more to page.

surface_type.description: Faces only: keep faces of this surface type.

name: find_entities
title: Find Model Entities
